open_questions.question: Which of the seven symmetry-distinct iCDW orders (mM2+, mM3+, mM4+ across occupied/unoccupied vHs) is actually realized in CsV3Sb5?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The subsidiary uniform magnetic order (ferro vs octupolar vs toroidal vs monopolar) and the observable magneto-electric/striction signatures depend entirely on which iCDW irrep condenses.
open_questions.next_step: Compute the DFT VHS orbital/sublattice content at M and evaluate which iCDW channel has the most attractive interaction; cross-check against measured Kerr/muSR TRS-breaking onset.

open_questions.question: Does the coupled theory select 3Q-3Q or 2Q-1Q for realistic AV3Sb5 coefficient values?
open_questions.why_it_matters: 3Q-3Q preserves C3 (magnetic orders) while 2Q-1Q is orthorhombic; experiments report nematicity, so the sign/magnitude of the biquadratic and quadrilinear coefficients is decisive.
open_questions.next_step: Fit lambda_ir(1), kappa_ir, u_i, u_r from a microscopic mean-field VHS model rather than treating them as free, then locate the physical point on our phase diagram.

open_questions.question: How does the arbitrary-sign trilinear gamma_ir (origin-dependent) affect the physical distinction between star-of-David and tri-hexagonal bond order?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The sign of N1 N2 N3 distinguishes SoD vs tri-hexagonal (Ref. 54); the theory says loop-current config is insensitive to sign(Phi1 Phi2 Phi3) but the rCDW config is not.
open_questions.next_step: Extend the minimizer to track sign(N1 N2 N3) and map which bond-order pattern accompanies each mixed phase across the diagram.

open_questions.question: What is the effect of the out-of-plane (kz) modulation and interlayer coupling on the mixed phase selection?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The paper notes 2x2x2 vs 2x2x4 stacking; interlayer terms could stabilize different mixed states than the single-layer analysis.
open_questions.next_step: Add a bilayer order-parameter doubling (above/below plane fields) and the symmetry-allowed interlayer couplings to the free energy and re-minimize.

open_questions.question: Does the SOC-induced SDW that necessarily accompanies iCDW change the energetics enough to shift the 3Q-3Q vs 2Q-1Q boundary?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The paper states iCDW triggers an SDW at the same wavevector under SOC; back-reaction of the SDW free energy could move the phase boundary.
open_questions.next_step: Add an SDW order parameter M_i coupled biquadratically to Phi_i and quantify the shift of the phase boundary.

Compute and tabulate the magneto-electric / magneto-striction response tensors for each 3Q-3Q subsidiary magnetic order to enable experimental discrimination.
Extend to a bilayer/interlayer free energy for out-of-plane modulation.
Couple in the SOC-induced SDW and re-map the phase diagram.
